tools.name: copperhead_check
tools.title: Verify the KiCad project
tools.description: Run ERC, DRC, doc-drift and spec validation on the project. Makes no model call and no network call, and changes nothing. Safe to call at any time, including concurrently.

tools.name: copperhead_doctor
tools.title: Check that this host can run copperhead
tools.description: Probe the environment copperhead needs: node, kicad-cli, git, openspec, and whether a model credential resolves. Makes no model call and no network call, and changes nothing. Call this first when another tool reports that something is unavailable.

tools.name: copperhead_init
tools.title: Scaffold design docs from the schematic
tools.description: Generate the docs/ memory scaffold from an existing schematic. Also installs a git pre-commit hook that runs copperhead check before each commit. Idempotent, and refuses rather than overwriting docs a human has hand-edited.

path.description: where to look for KiCad files, relative to the repo root

tools.name: copperhead_do
tools.title: Make a verified change to the project
tools.description: Run the full gated pipeline for a change request: propose, spec-gate, edit, verify with ERC/DRC, repair, and commit — or roll back to the pre-run state if verification cannot be satisfied. This is the only way to change the project. Long-running; progress is streamed. Requires an API key in the environment.

request.description: the change request, in natural language

dry_run.description: propose the change and write nothing

tools.name: copperhead_sync
tools.title: Verify design-state consistency, and optionally resolve drift
tools.description: Run the deterministic consistency check across docs, constraints and the KiCad files. With resolve=true, additionally run the gated loop to fix the drift it found. Requirement violations are always reported and never auto-resolved — those are for a human. resolve=true requires an API key in the environment.

resolve.description: run the LLM resolve phase for resolvable drift
